title: I love these!
text: I love these!. I love these soap pads.  They really help retain the mess of the soap. I also use it under my retainer case.  It allows the water to drain off, stops the soap from getting soggy.  `The price isn't bad for shipping being included.`

product_metadata.title: Pre de Provence CAMZ10926 Natural Dish Lift & Soap Holder Accessory, Drains Water, Circulates Air, Extends Life, and Prevents Mushy, 4.5 x 3 x 0.25, Soap Saver
features: SET - Includes 6 soap lifts that effectively raises soap off the soap dish or holder. Place on top of soap dish to help drain water and circulate air
MAKE THE SOAP LAST - Prevent bar soap from getting mushy, the porous design quickly drains water and allows air to circulate faster making soap last so much longer!
HIGH QUALITY - The multi-directional material gets rid of the messy residue that regular soap dishes can leave behind
FITS ANY BAR SOAP DISHES - Either place on top of bar soap dish or can be trimmed to fit soap dish if necessary. Place in soap dish, on shower shelves, or on counter tops.
EASY CARE - Rinses off easily or simply hand wash in warm water
description: Urban Spa soap up is a simple, elegant & extremely effective soap lift that raises the soap off the soap dish or soap holder surface; porous design to quickly drain water & circulate air to make the soap last longer. Very easy to clean, simply hand wash in warm water.
